evidence_scope: STATIC SOURCE INSPECTION ONLY; no live HP acceptance
policy: Each owner intent ID is an alias referencing existing AST pieces, never a duplicated source node. RED means missing, unclear, failed or unsafe; YELLOW means source found without independently passing behavior evidence; GREEN only with isolated test receipt; GRAY intended without located source. Colors belong to behavior acceptance, not just syntax.

aliases.intent: Read the real cursor position without changing input
aliases.reason: No cursor-position reader located in the v3.3.14 mapped source; no GetCursorPos/winfo_pointerx/y/follow_mouse references found
aliases.acceptance: Read cursor position repeatedly during motion, including multi-monitor negative coordinates; do not move mouse
aliases.next: Find an actual implementation in the correct version, or create isolated reader

aliases.intent: Animated spider follows real cursor at chosen distance and rotates correctly without stealing clicks
aliases.reason: PetOverlay.tick drifts one pixel horizontally during working state, not toward cursor; drawing is separate from following
aliases.acceptance: Drag mouse repeatedly; overlay follows with configurable offset, rotates toward travel, retains click-through and normal desktop operation
aliases.next: Test an isolated reader/follower/renderer against physical Windows HP; keep Forge v0.4 distinct

aliases.intent: Find and open Chrome without corrupting an existing profile
aliases.reason: Dedicated-profile launch exists, but owner's ordinary Chrome requirement is not proven
aliases.acceptance: Open permitted Chrome or report why unavailable; preserve signed-in regular profile and never delete lock/cookies

aliases.intent: Detect existing Chrome, active window, browser/profile state
aliases.reason: DevTools-profile attachment and desktop-window discovery are different partial mechanisms
aliases.acceptance: Identify browser HWND and explicit target identity; avoid attaching to an unrelated profile
aliases.next: Isolate regular Chrome foreground identity and recheck

aliases.intent: Inspect a selected Chrome tab without changing its contents
aliases.reason: CDP DOM summary does not verify existing ordinary Chrome UIA/visible inspection
aliases.acceptance: Return actual visible selected tab title and controlled read-only summary for regular Chrome; refuse unrelated target
aliases.next: Test CDP and UIA routes separately and annotate limitations

aliases.intent: Propose and execute an owner-approved Chrome action with target/response verification
aliases.reason: CDP prompt send and regular Chrome UNSENT draft staging differ; no proven end-to-end ordinary Chrome send
aliases.acceptance: Require owner approval, reject changed target/challenges, execute only authorized action and verify result; no duplicate sends
aliases.next: Isolate each action path; do not infer send from draft staging

aliases.intent: STOP promptly halts queued and in-flight actions and prevents stale responses from restarting them
aliases.reason: Source stop latch exists but full in-flight/stale action contract remains unverified on physical HP
aliases.acceptance: STOP during waiting/running/after-send race; no stale generation resumes until explicit owner action
aliases.next: Run isolated thread/race tests and a physical Windows acceptance test

aliases.intent: Verify exact foreground HWND/control identity before any mouse/keyboard actuation
aliases.reason: Window lookup/focus and mouse click exist but same-target-after-focus race is not proven
aliases.acceptance: Switch target windows between inspect and click; abort without clicking wrong target
aliases.next: Bind identity to approval and actuation; test stale/focus changes

aliases.intent: Append a tamper-evident evidence receipt and verify chain integrity
aliases.reason: Source found with hash, save and verify, but independent corruption and atomicity acceptance remains unverified
aliases.acceptance: Append, reload, verify; corrupt prior receipt and ensure append refuses; interrupt write and preserve existing data
aliases.next: Check variant-specific tamper behavior before GREEN
